about.title: About Andrea
about.bio.song: Most played song 2025: Prize Fighter - Armando Young (one of my favs)
about.bio.music: I make music in Ableton, big fan of Jamiroquai and Fiona Apple. Sampling and building sound kits is a 10/10.
about.text.p1: If you've peeked around here, thank you! Let's switch into chat mode :). It all started with music. Before I even knew what I wanted to do, I was obsessed with rhythm, layers, tiny details, and the music industry itself. That curiosity led me to graphic design: logos for bands, cover art, and identities for creative projects (and a few social ones, too). I've also always been a computer kid, so my interest in code and how websites and apps are built has been there from day one.
about.text.p2: These days I work as a design engineer after a path through product design. I care about the connection between technology and people: how we use apps every day, how they integrate with devices, and what makes an experience feel smooth, accessible, simple, and consistent. Music runs in parallel as Marces (Spotify link for now, website coming soon), and it's a project I'm looking forward to picking back up.
about.text.p3: Outside of work, I'm big on ergonomics and optimizing setups (yes, I'll look at your desk and immediately diagnose it). I also disappear into device and app reviews, especially where tech meets music. I read a lot, keep doing branding for fun, and sometimes invent projects just to give them an identity and bring them to life in code. I share that exploration through lemonims, my personal lab and small creative label.

resume.intro: 4+ years bridging product design and implementation, and currently leading design for one of ODILO's products. I've recently stepped fully into a Design Engineer scope, getting hands-on with code to translate design decisions into production-ready UI. I build and scale design systems from tokens to accessible, reusable component patterns, partnering closely with engineers to reduce rework, increase consistency, and ship faster with confidence.
